steps.what: List the district standards and the cupboard on-hand quantity for these materials.

Decide whether to authorize that purchase.
Draft order lines for the materials she authorized.

Place the order for those instructional materials and visual aids.

tasks.design: {DOCS} and the materials cupboard list the district standard and the on-hand quantity. tasks.still_hard: She still has to see the educational need and decide what to authorize.
tasks.human_edge: Whether a visual aid meets that student's need is her judgement against the district standard.

tasks.short: Update program content for current equipment

steps.what: List the stored educational program content for this equipment.
Notice which of those processes is no longer technologically current.
Write what must change so students are trained on current processes.
Draft replacement paragraphs for that educational program content.

loop.input: her change note and the stored paragraph for the equipment she named
loop.check: she checks that the draft still names the processes she marked and does not add a process the note does not state
loop.stop: one draft, then stop; if she rejects it she writes the paragraph herself
loop.why_not_simpler: the paragraph is prose, so a field copy cannot rewrite it from her note

steps.what: Check the draft still names the processes she marked as current.
File the checked educational program content in the record.
Tell the teacher which program content was filed.

tasks.design: {DOCS} lists the stored program content. A bounded draft rewrites only the paragraphs her note marks, she checks that the text still names those processes, and a gated step files that checked version. The draft does not file, nothing mails the teacher, and nothing raises an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rewriting a program paragraph meant retyping prose that had to stay faithful to her note.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded rewrite of a stored paragraph from a short note is a small loop, and she still checks the meaning.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to notice which process is no longer current, and she still tells the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can tell that a process on the floor is no longer the one the program describes.
tasks.altitude: She still notices what is no longer current, writes the change, checks the paragraph and tells the teacher. A paragraph she has accepted is filed without retyping.

evidence.claim: LessonUp rewrites slide text by tone or level, and can translate and make word lists. The draft here rewrites a stored program paragraph from the coordinator's own note, and she checks it before it is filed. LessonUp is not claimed to file a program or to save a measured share of this task.

AI Act Annex III point 3 treats admission, evaluating learning outcomes, steering learning, assessing level and test proctoring as high-risk. This draft does not score a student and does not set a result. She checks the paragraph before it is filed.
The range is a judgement that noticing, the change note, the check and telling the teacher stay. No trial figure from this digest is used as this task's saving. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The list uses program id and the stored paragraphs for the named equipment. The producer is whoever last filed the program, before this task. That capture sits outside this task and is not counted as saved. Her change note is written in this task, at full time, before the draft. The draft may use only that note and those paragraphs. A blank paragraph stays blank. If she rejects the draft she writes the paragraph herself. The file writes only the checked version program-content-v1 into {DOCS}. A later edit voids the check. The draft does not file. Nothing mails the teacher. Nothing raises an alert. The paragraph is not a grade and does not name a pupil.
unknowns: Whether this employer's program paragraphs are stored as text a draft can read, and who may file a change.
research_questions: Which program paragraphs are in the document store, and who is allowed to file a new version?

already_counted.description: Check that the draft still names the processes she marked. That reading is the check step.

incremental.description: Correct the filed paragraph when her change note named the wrong equipment. The file does not mail the teacher.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A program update where the old paragraphs are stored and she has already written what must change.
